reviews.text:

But ok, this could be something worthwhile. Then, today, I had a promotion of 40% less to access to more features…. But then… not! Also says that I have free access to the chat with the Insights but then… not. It is an extra cost.
 I contacted again their support team, which was extremely helpful and efficient. They retuned the money. It is a good idea with a poor User Experience in many ways. Too bad, it had the potential.
